questions.question: Which is the fastest bird in the world during a dive?
questions.hint: The Peregrine Falcon can exceed 320 km/h (200 mph) during its hunting dive, making it the fastest animal on Earth.

questions.question: Which desert is the largest cold desert in the world?
questions.hint: Although many think of hot deserts, Antarctica is actually the world's largest desert because it receives very little precipitation.

questions.question: Which fictional kingdom is ruled by Queen Elsa?
questions.hint: Arendelle is the kingdom featured in Disney's Frozen.

questions.question: Which actor played Neo in The Matrix?
questions.hint: Keanu Reeves became famous worldwide for portraying Neo in The Matrix series.

questions.question: Which invention is credited to Johannes Gutenberg?
questions.hint: The movable-type printing press revolutionized the spread of books and knowledge in Europe.

questions.question: Which international organization works to protect children's rights worldwide?
questions.hint: UNICEF focuses on improving children's health, education, and welfare across the globe.

questions.question: Which ancient city was destroyed by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius?
questions.hint: Pompeii was buried under volcanic ash in AD 79, preserving much of the ancient city.

questions.question: Which civilization built the city of Machu Picchu?
questions.hint: The Incas built Machu Picchu high in the Andes Mountains of Peru.

questions.question: Which country originated the sport of badminton?
questions.hint: The modern game developed from 'Poona,' a game played in British India before being standardized in England.

questions.question: How many players are on a volleyball team on the court at one time?
questions.hint: Each volleyball team has six players on the court during play.

questions.question: Which country is home to the city of Istanbul?
questions.hint: Istanbul is Turkey's largest city and uniquely spans both Europe and Asia.

questions.question: Which is the world's largest island?
questions.hint: Australia is classified as a continent, making Greenland the world's largest island.

questions.question: Which scientist proposed the three laws of motion?
questions.hint: Newton's laws of motion became the foundation of classical physics.

questions.question: Which gas do plants release during photosynthesis?
questions.hint: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen as a by-product of photosynthesis.

questions.question: Which country is famous for the traditional musical instrument called the didgeridoo?
questions.hint: The didgeridoo is a traditional wind instrument developed by Aboriginal Australians.

questions.question: Which country celebrates the Day of the Dead (Día de los Muertos)?
questions.hint: The Day of the Dead honors loved ones who have passed away through colorful traditions and celebrations.

questions.question: Which ocean animal is the largest living creature on Earth?
questions.hint: Blue whales can grow over 30 meters (98 feet) long and weigh more than 170 tons.

questions.question: Which European country has the shape of a boot?
questions.hint: Italy is well known for its distinctive boot-shaped peninsula.

questions.question: Which planet rotates on its side compared to most other planets?
questions.hint: Uranus rotates at an angle of about 98 degrees, making it appear to roll around the Sun.

questions.question: Which explorer first reached India by sailing around Africa?
questions.hint: Vasco da Gama's voyage opened a direct sea route between Europe and India in 1498.
